summary: The PRDocuments file defines a web user control for managing Placement Request Documents. It enables users to upload, edit, delete, and view documents related to placement requests within an ASP.NET application. The control interacts with a backend data layer, processes file uploads, manages document metadata, and handles business logic such as document type selection, validation, and workflow exceptions.
purpose: To provide a user interface and backend logic for managing documents linked to placement requests, facilitating upload, edit, deletion, and viewing, with specific validation and business rules applied.

workflows.name: Upload/Edit Placement Request Document
steps: User selects a document for upload using FileUpload control.
System validates file existence and retrieves file metadata (name, size, type).
System generates a unique folder and path, saves the file, and creates a URL.
Document details are bound to the form and metadata fields are updated.
User selects document type from dropdown (excludes 'StudProf' code).
System saves document metadata and file info in PlacementRequestDocument.
If editing, previous document file is deleted.
System updates document in database and refreshes display.

workflows.name: Delete Placement Request Document
steps: User clicks delete on GridView row.
System deletes document record and associated file.
System redirects and refreshes the page.

workflows.name: View Placement Request Document Details
steps: User clicks edit/view on GridView row.
System checks if document exists for the selected row.
System binds document details to FormView for editing or viewing.

business_rules: Document type dropdown omits 'StudProf' (Student Profile) code.
If no updated details exist, hide the update details panel.
'Profile' document type is treated as a special case, hiding type and comments controls.
Only users with a valid session and editable screen can perform document actions.
validations: CustomValidator1 and ValidationSummary3 controls for form validation.
Document upload checks for non-empty file and valid upload.
Document type 'Other' triggers additional comment validation via JavaScript.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable flag determines if edit/delete actions are available.
If PlacementRequestDocument TypeCodeID == 0, document does not exist.
If document ID <= 0, a new document is being created.
system_behavior: Redirects user after document actions, adding locale and context to URL.
Binds document data on FormView and GridView events.
Calls backend DataLayer functions for retrieval and modification.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, document actions are cancelled.
If file upload fails or is invalid, document is not saved.
If document type is 'profile', non-relevant fields are hidden and not validated.
content_gaps: No explicit description of user roles or permissions beyond session.
No direct calculation logic for document metadata; relies on upload and system APIs.
Does not specify error handling for file system failures or database exceptions.
